description: Rubric for scripts/score_audit.py. Each check says which track it belongs to (technical or content) and how it relates to Google: a technical requirement, documented guidance, or just our own hygiene check. Weights are our judgment of how directly a problem can stop pages being crawled or indexed. They are not measured effects on rankings. Change a weight, check or threshold only with a version bump.

weight_scale.5: Can stop important pages being crawled or indexed, or breaks many pages at once.
weight_scale.4: Gives search engines contradictory signals, or breaks links or titles widely.
weight_scale.3: Common problem that makes pages harder to understand or show.

basis_scale.requirement: One of Google's technical requirements for being indexed (Search Essentials).
basis_scale.guidance: Google documents it as recommended practice. The link is Google's page on the topic.
basis_scale.hygiene: Our own check. Google does not state it as a rule.

score_formula: Check score = max(0, 1 - sensitivity x affected / total). Area and overall score = 100 x weighted average of the checks that were measured.

checks.why: The audited URL must return a successful response.
checks.fix: Make the page return HTTP 200 for everyone; check server errors, redirects and blocks.

checks.why: An unreachable robots.txt makes compliant crawlers stop.
checks.fix: Make /robots.txt return 200 (or 404 if you have none) and fix server errors on it.

checks.why: robots.txt must not disallow the audited path for Googlebot.
checks.fix: Remove the robots.txt Disallow rule that blocks this page for Googlebot.

checks.why: The final URL should be served over HTTPS.
checks.fix: Redirect http:// to https:// and serve the site over HTTPS.

checks.why: Our own limit. Googlebot generally follows about 10 hops, but fewer hops are faster and safer.
checks.fix: Redirect straight to the final URL in one hop.

checks.why: http, https and www variants should resolve to one preferred URL.
checks.fix: Pick one preferred address (https, www or not) and 301-redirect the others to it.

checks.why: A nonexistent URL should return an error status, not 200 or a redirect home.
checks.fix: Return a real 404 for pages that do not exist (not 200, not a redirect to home).

checks.why: A sitemap helps discovery but is not required.
checks.fix: Publish a sitemap.xml and list it in robots.txt.

checks.why: A sitemap that exists should be parseable and within limits.
checks.fix: Fix the sitemap: valid XML, full URLs, under 50,000 URLs and 50 MB per file.

checks.why: 5xx responses stop pages being fetched.
checks.fix: Fix the 5xx errors on these URLs; check the server logs.

checks.why: Crawled URLs that return 4xx are broken targets.
checks.fix: Fix or remove links to these 4xx pages; redirect pages that moved.

checks.why: Network or TLS failures stop pages being fetched.
checks.fix: Fix the network or TLS failure on these URLs.

checks.why: A sitemap URL with noindex is a contradictory signal.
checks.fix: Take noindex pages out of the sitemap, or remove the noindex.

checks.why: Canonicals pointing at redirecting, erroring or noindex pages are ignored or harmful.
checks.fix: Point canonicals at a live, indexable page that returns 200.

checks.why: Conflicting canonical declarations weaken the signal.
checks.fix: Keep one canonical per page.

checks.why: Meta robots and X-Robots-Tag should agree.
checks.fix: Make meta robots and X-Robots-Tag say the same thing.

checks.why: Our own limit. Googlebot generally follows about 10 hops, but chains of two or more waste requests.
checks.fix: Link or redirect straight to the final URL.

checks.why: Redirect loops make URLs unreachable.
checks.fix: Break the redirect loop so the URL reaches a real page.

checks.why: Redirects that end in an error lose the destination.
checks.fix: Point the redirect at a page that works.

checks.why: Sitemap URLs should return 200.
checks.fix: Keep only URLs that return 200 in the sitemap.

checks.why: Sitemap URLs should not be noindex or canonicalized elsewhere.
checks.fix: Keep only indexable, canonical URLs in the sitemap.

checks.why: Sitemap URLs that robots.txt disallows contradict each other.
checks.fix: Do not list URLs in the sitemap that robots.txt blocks, or unblock them.

checks.why: Internal links to 4xx/5xx pages break navigation and waste link signals.
checks.fix: Fix or remove links to pages that are missing.

checks.why: Links should point at final URLs.
checks.fix: Change links to point at the final URL, not the redirecting one.

checks.why: Internal http:// links on an https site cause redirects and duplicate fetches.
checks.fix: Change internal http:// links to https://.

checks.why: Links without a name give no context.
checks.fix: Give every link visible text, image alt text or an aria-label.

checks.why: Generic anchors say little about the target.
checks.fix: Replace 'click here' and 'read more' with words that describe the target.

checks.why: Sitemap URLs with no internal link are hard to discover; only judged when the crawl was complete.
checks.fix: Link to these pages from related pages, or take them out of the sitemap.

checks.why: A page without a title gives search engines and users nothing to show.
checks.fix: Add a unique <title> to every page.

checks.why: More than one title element is ambiguous.
checks.fix: Keep one <title> per page.

checks.why: Indexable pages sharing a title are hard to tell apart.
checks.fix: Write a different title for each page.

checks.why: Descriptions are optional; engines may write their own snippet.
checks.fix: Add a short meta description where the default snippet is poor.

checks.why: Repeated descriptions add little.
checks.fix: Write a different description for each page.

checks.why: A visible main heading helps users and parsers.
checks.fix: Add one clear <h1> to each page.

checks.why: Repeated main headings suggest templated content.
checks.fix: Give each page its own <h1>.

checks.why: Identical visible text across indexable URLs competes with itself.
checks.fix: Merge, redirect or canonicalize pages with identical text, or make them different.

checks.why: A document language helps interpretation.
checks.fix: Set <html lang="..."> (for example en).

checks.why: Without a viewport tag pages render at desktop width on phones.
checks.fix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">.

checks.why: Unparseable JSON-LD is ignored.
checks.fix: Fix the JSON syntax in the structured data.

checks.why: An object without @type cannot be interpreted.
checks.fix: Add an @type to each structured data object.

checks.why: Placeholder values mean markup that does not match the page.
checks.fix: Replace placeholder values like [Company Name] with real data.

checks.why: Images without an alt attribute lose their text equivalent; alt="" for decorative images is fine.
checks.fix: Add alt text to content images (use alt="" for decorative ones).

checks.why: Missing width/height can cause layout shift.
checks.fix: Add width and height to images so the page does not jump while loading.

checks.why: Invalid language or region codes are ignored.
checks.fix: Use valid language and region codes such as en or fr-CA.

checks.why: Each page should list itself in its hreflang set.
checks.fix: Include the page's own URL in its hreflang list.

checks.why: hreflang annotations need confirmation from the target.
checks.fix: Make each alternate page link back to this one.

checks.why: Alternates that redirect, error or are noindex cannot be served.
checks.fix: Point hreflang at live, indexable pages.

checks.why: Origin-level real-user Core Web Vitals on phones.
checks.fix: Improve the weakest Core Web Vital (LCP, INP or CLS) on phones across the site.

checks.why: URL-level real-user Core Web Vitals on phones, when data exists.
checks.fix: Improve the weakest Core Web Vital (LCP, INP or CLS) on phones for this page.

checks.why: Lab Largest Contentful Paint (ms); lab data, kept separate from field data. Verify thresholds at audit time.
checks.fix: Speed up the largest element on screen: image size, server time, render-blocking files.

checks.why: Lab Cumulative Layout Shift. Verify thresholds at audit time.
checks.fix: Reserve space for images, ads and embeds so the page does not jump.

checks.why: Lab Total Blocking Time (ms), a lab proxy and not field INP. Verify thresholds at audit time.
checks.fix: Cut heavy JavaScript that blocks the main thread.

unscored_checks.rendering.client_rendered_cue: Heuristic cue; needs a browser to confirm.
unscored_checks.sitemap.indexable_not_listed: Not every page belongs in a sitemap.

not_covered: Content quality, intent match and usefulness
Experience, expertise, authority and trust signals
Search demand, rankings and actual indexing status
Local, ecommerce and other specialized branches
Content that needs JavaScript to appear (the crawl reads raw HTML)
